A1.pairwise_controls: BP remains an external comparator for every pair; the leave-parent-out fixed method is selected only from that pair.
A1.uncertainty: Report all five parent scores and full parent-removal refits. No extra split search or unplanned significance test.

A2.sampling_order: parent order 41011..41015 then task DO/DC/PU/BP; generate a 20000 x 100 integer index array per stratum
A2.sampled_policy_order: parent, dose625_4201, dose625_4202, alternate4k_4201, alternate4k_4202, mixture_4201, mixture_4202
A2.contrast_order: parent, combinations of (dose625,alternate4k,mixture), then 4201,4202,4202-minus-4201; first method minus second
A2.zero_SE: Exclude from max statistic, record degenerate interval, cannot pass affirmative screen
A2.preservation: Save all resampled indices, all seven-policy bootstrap means, all 45 bootstrap contrasts

A3.windows: step > lower and step <= upper; pretraining 20k, continuation 4k
A3.episode_returns: Full 500-step training episodes only; success means any success within the episode
A3.counters: Subtract cumulative counters at window start, including parent200k counters at branch start
A3.raw_metrics: Retain every recorded 250-step snapshot, no interpolation or fabricated entropy/action history
A3.prefix: z from first two 4k windows, valid when >=12 TD snapshots in each; descriptive only, no stopping-rule fit without B labels
A3.association: No post-hoc threshold is used as an inferential test or to change the frozen score
